summary: Five of six seats returned schema-valid responses at xhigh; Qwen exceeded its 600 second wall-clock budget and returned nothing. One seat approved, three asked for revision and one blocked. Fourteen concerns: three seats agree that role-scoped value rules have no installed probe, and two that the notes reconciliation does not cover the freeze commit or every shipped surface. Nine concerns come from one seat each.

agreed_concerns.title: Role-scoped value rules have no installed probe and no stated reason
agreed_concerns.summary: W7 lists role-scoped value rules as a user-visible change, and probe 3 exercises no such model. No table maps each change to a probe or to a reason for having none.

agreed_concerns.title: The notes reconciliation does not cover the freeze commit or every shipped surface
agreed_concerns.summary: RW1-C3 reads the diff over src and docs at the RW1 base. Later merges, and changes to pyproject.toml, PYPI.md and the manifests, are outside it, and the RW2-C0 recheck names no scope.

prioritized_fixes.title: Probe role-scoped value rules and reconcile every change with a probe or a reason
prioritized_fixes.action: Probe 3 gains a role-scoped value model. The RW2 spec maps each W7 change and each source change merged by the freeze to an installed probe with its 0.4.0 control or to a stated reason, and the RW3 dossier lists the uncovered rows.

prioritized_fixes.title: Reconcile the exact freeze commit across every shipped surface
prioritized_fixes.action: RW1-C3 and the RW2-C0 recheck read the diff from v0.4.0 over src, docs, README.md, PYPI.md, pyproject.toml, LICENSE, NOTICE and the plugin manifest directories, file by file, at the commit the candidate is built from.

prioritized_fixes.title: Bind the freeze, the probe merge and the build to one commit
prioritized_fixes.action: The probes pull request and any preparation pull request merge first. The freeze commit is the resulting main commit and is the SOURCE_COMMIT of both builds. If main moves before the build, RW2-C0 runs again.

prioritized_fixes.title: Assert what the exported programs contain, in every advertised mode
prioritized_fixes.action: Probe 3 exports in the default mode and with both rules targets where the notes advertise them, and asserts the rule content or the documented refusal, each with a 0.4.0 control.

prioritized_fixes.title: Compare the served files before the tag and the GitHub release
prioritized_fixes.action: The publication stage runs the served-file comparison and the fresh index install right after the upload.

prioritized_fixes.title: Name the structure guards in the RW2 and RW3 gates
prioritized_fixes.action: The section 9 rows of RW2 and RW3 list the project.md guard block.

prioritized_fixes.title: Move the pinned releasing sentence in the helper and its test with the page
prioritized_fixes.action: RW3 edits the STANDING entry of tools/release_text.py and the fixture of tests/test_release_text.py together with docs/releasing.md. That helper change is the trigger of RC-03, so the receipts negative control lands with it.

prioritized_fixes.title: Run the E1 base lane at the commit the bump is applied to
prioritized_fixes.action: The base run and the bumped run use the same commit, named in the first RW1 ruling, so the version fields are the only difference.

prioritized_fixes.title: State in the plan what each retired 0.3.0 control checked
prioritized_fixes.action: The plan lists the four 0.3.0 availability assertions and says each retires without a replacement because 0.4.0 has the feature, while the candidate behavior control of each probe stays.

prioritized_fixes.title: Check the runtime environment the oracle lane needs
prioritized_fixes.action: The plan records that the tutorials runtime environment imports on the machine that will run the lane, and RW2 rechecks it before the freeze.

prioritized_fixes.title: Say which decision names the headline block
prioritized_fixes.action: The notes paragraph cites plan decision RW-D3 and the RW1 spec decision D4 by their own names.
